module.summary: UTF-8 helpers: code point to UTF-8, moving across character boundaries, and backspace/delete by character.

UnicodeToUtf8.desc: Encodes a Unicode code point into a 1-4 byte UTF-8 string; returns nil for ch==0 or values beyond the UTF-16 range.

Utf8PrevChar.desc: Returns the byte position where the UTF-8 character before startPos begins (never below 1).
Utf8PrevChar.returns: start position of the previous character

Utf8NextChar.desc: Returns the byte position after the character at pos, advancing by that character's UTF-8 byte length.

Utf8BackspaceAt.desc: Deletes the UTF-8 character before pos (no change when pos<=1) and returns the new string plus the new cursor position.

Utf8DeleteAt.desc: Deletes the whole UTF-8 character at pos and returns the new string.

fileDesc: UTF-8 encoding/decoding and per-character editing helpers.
